mapper.select: select t.terminal_id, t.terminal_cd, t.plant_cd from sys_terminal t where t.terminal_id = #{terminalId} and t.revoked_at is null
select exists (select 1 from mst_worker w where w.worker_id = #{workerId} and w.use_yn = 'Y')

select wp.wo_proc_id, wp.wo_id, wp.proc_id, p.proc_cd, w.item_id, i.item_class_id, w.plant_cd from prd_wo_proc wp join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = wp.wo_id join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = wp.proc_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id where wp.wo_proc_id = #{woProcId}

select l.lot_no from prd_result r join lot_master l on l.lot_id = r.lot_id where r.wo_proc_id = #{woProcId} and r.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from prd_result x where x.reversal_of_id = r.result_id) order by
r.occurred_at, r.result_id r.occurred_at desc, r.result_id desc
limit 1
select l.lot_id from lot_master l where l.lot_no = #{lotNo} and l.wo_id = #{woId}

select h.insp_id, h.insp_no, h.result, h.judged_at from qms_insp h join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id where h.insp_type = #{type} and l.lot_no = #{lotNo} and h.proc_id is not distinct from #{procId}::bigint and h.status = 'OPEN' order by h.insp_id desc limit 1

select h.insp_id, h.insp_no, h.result, h.judged_at from qms_insp h join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id where h.insp_type = #{type} and l.wo_id = #{woId} and h.proc_id is not distinct from #{procId}::bigint and h.status = 'JUDGED' order by h.judged_at desc, h.insp_id desc limit 1
select h.insp_id, h.insp_no, h.result, h.judged_at from qms_insp h where h.open_req_id = #{req}

select h.insp_id, h.insp_no, h.insp_type, h.status, h.result, l.lot_no, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, p.proc_cd, w.plant_cd from qms_insp h join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = h.item_id left join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = h.proc_id left join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = l.wo_id where h.insp_id = #{inspId}
